title: AlphaForgeContract
description: AlphaForge AI contracts v0.4.0. Generated from core/models.py; do not edit by hand.

text.description: Rendered text: the code replaced every {{ev_id}} marker

weight_grid.description: Optional (v0.3.0): verdict of the same rules for each tested weight

ConfirmedPreferences.description: Preferences extracted from the investor's note AND confirmed by them in the UI.
ConfirmedPreferences.title: ConfirmedPreferences

intended_weight.description: Target portfolio share after the addition

DiversificationImpact.description: Diversification analyst: does the asset add a new source of risk or duplicate one?

correlations.description: Monthly correlation with each other held position, desc.

DiversificationImpact.title: DiversificationImpact

mention.description: Optional (v0.3.0): does the headline name the held company?

linked_ticker.description: Optional (v0.3.0): held position the item is linked to (e.g. bond ETF for macro)

coherence.description: Present only if a consideration was given

data_quality.description: Optional (v0.4.0): quality report of each analyzed position

Governance.description: Governance agent: constraints, simulation boundaries and missing information, made visible.
Governance.title: Governance

window.description: e.g. day before to +5 trading days

caveats.description: Mandatory: sample, overlap, survivorship, not a forecast

InstrumentProfile.description: Risk analyst: what you really own with this instrument and the risks to understand (rules text).
InstrumentProfile.title: InstrumentProfile

horizon_relevance.description: Comes from the taxonomy, not the model

NewsCluster.description: Same event reported by several outlets, shown as one card.
NewsCluster.title: NewsCluster

PreferenceExtraction.description: Suggestions only: nothing is applied until the investor confirms them.
PreferenceExtraction.title: PreferenceExtraction

quote.description: Verbatim words of the note that justify the suggestion

Profile.description: Investor profile computed by rules (never by the LLM).

confirmed_from_note.description: Optional (v0.3.0): preferences added from the investor's note and confirmed

Profile.title: Profile

QualityReport.description: Data-quality gate of one asset (core/quality.py). No verdict is computed on 'blocking' data.
QualityReport.title: QualityReport

ToolCall.description: One tool call made by the orchestrator agent (shows the agentic side).

forced.description: True when the code called the tool because the model did not

planner.description: Model id that chose the call, or 'mock' offline

ToolCall.title: ToolCall

weight.description: Share of the total amount outside the universe

rule_id.description: Rule concerned; null for the overall verdict
